description:
Cast Corpse Cur.
When Corpse Cur ETBs, Corpse Cur and Molten Echoes trigger.
Allow the Corpse Cur trigger to fizzle.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Corpse Cur, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Corpse Cur.
The token copy of Corpse Cur triggers on ETB, returning the original Corpse Cur to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the token copy of Corpse Cur, adding {C}{C} Repeat.
